description: Routine Inflection pipeline-correctness cleanup. Triggered by one observation 2026-05-15 -- the Segment Analytics WA account count read 685 then 744; the investigation answered it: 744 is correct, 685 was a defective 06:00 build being corrected (not a methodology change; INF_D_04 code unchanged since 2026-05-14). Plus minor INF_D_04 client_portal_summary.py internal-consistency cleanup (geo state-vs-sum-of-cities, a histogram excluded-count, radial_12m partial-decomposition labeling, a dual client_count source). Not an urgent project -- ordinary pipeline fixes; framing right-sized per the CTO ruling 2026-05-15.
